dim_unfocused_color.title: Dim Unfocused Color
dim_unfocused_color.description: Dim color of the unfocused windows.

drop_color.title: Drop Target Color
drop_color.description: Color of the drop target rectangle shown while dragging a tiled window.

focus_color.title: Active Border
focus_color.description: Focused window border on the selected monitor

maximized_screen_color.title: Maximized Border
maximized_screen_color.description: Border color for a focused maximized window.

scratchpad_color.title: Scratchpad Border Color
scratchpad_color.description: Border color for a focused scratchpad window.

global_color.title: Global Border Color
global_color.description: Border color for a focused global window.

exec.title: Run on Load/Reload
exec.description: Commands run at startup and every time the config is reloaded.

source.title: Includes
source.description: Config files loaded as part of this config.

source_optional.title: Optional Includes
source_optional.description: Config files loaded if they exist; missing files are ignored.

env.title: Environment
env.description: Environment variables exported before startup and re-applied on every config reload.

var.title: Variables
var.description: User-defined variables referenced as $name or ${name} in config values and binding keys; undefined names are left untouched.

bind.title: Key bindings
bind.description: Keyboard bindings by key mode and key combination.

mousebind.title: Mouse bindings
mousebind.description: Mouse bindings by key mode and button combination.

axisbind.title: Axis bindings
axisbind.description: Scroll axis bindings by key mode and direction.

gesturebind.title: Gesture bindings
gesturebind.description: Gesture bindings by key mode and gesture combination.

switchbind.title: Switch bindings
switchbind.description: Switch bindings by key mode and fold state.

rr.title: Transform
rr.description: Monitor transform. 0 normal, 1 90° CCW, 2 180°, 3 270° CCW, 4 vertical flip, 5 flip+90° CCW, 6 flip+180°, 7 flip+270° CCW.

hdr.title: HDR
hdr.description: Turn on HDR for this output. Requires the wl-only Vulkan build; not supported with scenefx.

hdr_min_lum.title: HDR Min Luminance
hdr_min_lum.description: Mastering display minimum luminance, cd/m² (0 = unset). No effect on wlroots 0.20.x.

hdr_max_lum.title: HDR Max Luminance
hdr_max_lum.description: Mastering display peak luminance, also sent as max_cll, cd/m² (0 = unset)

hdr_max_avg_lum.title: HDR Max Average Luminance
hdr_max_avg_lum.description: Max frame-average light level (max_fall), cd/m² (0 = unset)

hdr_force.title: Force HDR
hdr_force.description: Skip the EDID BT.2020/PQ checks when hdr is on. HDR requires the wl-only Vulkan build.

icc.title: ICC Profile
icc.description: Path to an ICC profile. Ignored when HDR is on.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: Make this monitor the X11 (RandR) primary output for XWayland

custom.title: Custom Mode
custom.description: Use a custom display mode. Not supported by all displays; can cause a black screen.

items.title: Monitor Rules
items.description: Match outputs by name, make, model, or serial; every field set must match. The first matching rule is applied to each output.

id.title: Tag ID
id.description: Tag id to match; 0 targets the special workspace (tag 0). Use * for all tags.

layout_name.title: Layout
layout_name.description: Layout to apply to this tag.

no_render_border.title: No Render Border
no_render_border.description: Do not draw window borders on this tag.

open_as_floating.title: Open as Floating
open_as_floating.description: Open new windows floating on this tag.

no_hide.title: Persistent Tag
no_hide.description: Keep the tag advertised to ext-workspace clients when it is empty.

master_factor.title: Master Factor
master_factor.description: Fraction of the tag area used by the master area (0.1-0.9).

scroller_default_proportion.title: Scroller Proportion
scroller_default_proportion.description: Default width proportion for new windows.

scroller_default_proportion_single.title: Scroller Proportion (Single)
scroller_default_proportion_single.description: Scroller proportion for a single window. Only used when scroller_ignore_proportion_single is off.

scroller_ignore_proportion_single.title: Ignore Single Proportion
scroller_ignore_proportion_single.description: Ignore proportion adjustments for single windows.

items.title: Tag Rules
items.description: Set layout, master, and scroller options per tag; every monitor field set must match.

layer_name.title: Layer Name
layer_name.description: Match name of layer, supports regex

animation_type_open.title: Open Animation
animation_type_open.description: Layer surface open animation. Empty inherits the global setting; `none` disables it.

animation_type_close.title: Close Animation
animation_type_close.description: Layer surface close animation. Empty inherits the global setting; `none` disables it.

shield_when_capture.title: Shield When Captured
shield_when_capture.description: Black out this layer while a screen capture is active; pair with no_animation:1.

items.title: Layer Rules
items.description: Configure layer-shell surfaces such as bars, launchers, and notifications.

title.title: Title
title.description: Match by window title, supports regex

app_id.title: App ID
app_id.description: Match by application ID, supports regex

animation_type_open.title: Open Animation
animation_type_open.description: Window open animation. Empty inherits the global setting; `none` disables it.

animation_type_close.title: Close Animation
animation_type_close.description: Window close animation. Empty inherits the global setting; `none` disables it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Assign to one tag, several tags separated by |, or the special workspace with 0.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.description: Assign to monitor by monitor spec (name, make, model, or serial)

offset_x.title: X Offset
offset_x.description: X offset from center (%), 100 is the edge of screen with outer gap

offset_y.title: Y Offset
offset_y.description: Y offset from center (%), 100 is the edge of screen with outer gap

no_focus.title: No Focus
no_focus.description: Never give this window keyboard focus.

no_force_center.title: No Force Center
no_force_center.description: Do not center the window automatically.

width.title: Width
width.description: Values greater than 0 and up to 1 are a fraction of the screen width; values above 1 are pixels.

height.title: Height
height.description: Values greater than 0 and up to 1 are a fraction of the screen height; values above 1 are pixels.

is_tag_silent.title: Tag Silent
is_tag_silent.description: Do not focus the window when it opens on a tag that is not currently visible.

is_named_scratchpad.title: Named Scratchpad
is_named_scratchpad.description: Mark the window as a named scratchpad toggled by toggle_named_scratchpad.

is_unmanaged_global.title: Unmanaged Global
is_unmanaged_global.description: Open as unmanaged global window (for desktop pets or camera windows)

is_global.title: Global
is_global.description: Open as global window (sticky across tags)

scroller_proportion_single.title: Scroller Proportion (Single)
scroller_proportion_single.description: Width proportion used while this window is the only tiled window (0.1-1.0).

is_overlay.title: Overlay
is_overlay.description: Keep the window in the top layer.

shield_when_capture.title: Shield When Captured
shield_when_capture.description: Fill the window with black while a screen capture is active.

allow_shortcuts_inhibit.title: Allow Shortcuts Inhibit
allow_shortcuts_inhibit.description: Let this window's client inhibit compositor shortcuts.

ignore_maximize.title: Ignore Maximize
ignore_maximize.description: Ignore maximize requests from the client.

ignore_minimize.title: Ignore Minimize
ignore_minimize.description: Ignore minimize requests from the client.

no_size_hint.title: No Size Hint
no_size_hint.description: Ignore the client's minimum and maximum size hints when resizing.

idle_inhibit_when_focus.title: Inhibit Idle When Focused
idle_inhibit_when_focus.description: Automatically keep idle inhibit active when this window is focused

vrr_only_fullscreen.title: VRR Only Fullscreen
vrr_only_fullscreen.description: Turn on VRR only while this window is fullscreen. Requires vrr off in its monitor rule.

force_render.title: Force Render
force_render.description: Force render frame even if the window is not visible

activation_bypass.title: Activation Bypass
activation_bypass.description: Treat activation requests for this window as authenticated.

is_term.title: Terminal
is_term.description: Mark the window as a terminal that a newly opened window replaces.

allow_csd.title: Allow CSD
allow_csd.description: Let clients draw their own window decorations.

force_fake_maximize.title: Force Fake Maximize
force_fake_maximize.description: Report the window as maximized to the client while keeping the tiled geometry.

force_tiled_state.title: Force Tiled State
force_tiled_state.description: Report the window as tiled even when it is floating.

anyOf.title: Force Tearing
anyOf.description: Tearing override: 0 unspecified, 1 enabled, 2 disabled. Enabling still requires global allow_tearing.

force_tearing.title: Force Tearing
force_tearing.description: Tearing override: 0 unspecified, 1 enabled, 2 disabled. Enabling still requires global allow_tearing.

no_swallow.title: No Swallow
no_swallow.description: Do not let this window replace an is_term window.

confine_pointer.title: Confine Pointer
confine_pointer.description: Keep the pointer inside this window while it is focused and visible.

scroller_proportion.title: Scroller Proportion
scroller_proportion.description: Width proportion for this window in the scroller layout (0.1-1.0).

is_fake_fullscreen.title: Fake Fullscreen
is_fake_fullscreen.description: Report fullscreen state to the client without resizing the window.

global_key_binding.description: Global keybinding written as MOD-KEY, for example ctrl+alt-o (Wayland apps only).

items.description: Override settings for devices matched by exact name or type. A keyboard rule compiles its own keymap from only the kb_* fields it sets.
